height_decode: v = R*256 + G (B = 0); metres = lo + v/65535*(hi-lo); metres are relative to the MOLA areoid
projection: orthographic (tangent plane) centred on (lat, lon) on the 3396.19 km Mars 2000 sphere; image row 0 = north edge, +x = east, +y = north; pixel centres at ((i+0.5)/n - 0.5)*extent. Heights are NOT curvature-corrected: the sphere falls away from the tangent plane by r^2/(2R) (~66 m at 20 km, ~13.2 km at the 300 km context edge).

notes: height.png: HRSC/MOLA blended DEM 200 m + USGS CTX DTM 20 m blended over the central 25% of the patch, bilinear to 58.6 m/px. color.webp: Murray Lab global CTX mosaic V01 (5 m/px, quads E076_N16), 5x5 box-averaged then bilinear to 29.3 m/px, greyscale, 0.5-99.5 percentile stretch. tint.webp and context-color.webp: Viking MDIM 2.1 colour mosaic (~232 m native, Trek zoom 7 ~325 m/px); use tint as a low-frequency colour multiplier for the greyscale CTX. context-height.png: HRSC/MOLA blend, 1 km box-averaged, bilinear to 1172 m/px. Jezero height: CTX DTM (20 m, resampled from 40 m blocks) covers 25% of the patch (77.16-77.70E, 18.21-18.72N), shifted by +2.5 m (median offset to the HRSC/MOLA blend) and feathered over ~1.4 km into the 200 m HRSC/MOLA blend elsewhere. The 1 m HiRISE DTM (1.8 GB, 77.22-77.58E 18.31-18.67N) exists but is ~60x finer than height.png's 58.6 m/px, so the 20 m CTX DTM was used instead; the visible rectangle in a hillshade is the CTX DTM footprint (sharper texture inside).
